title: AttemptResponse
description: The slice's branches an earlier attempt left, dropped after its worktrees were set aside and removed, each with its commit; empty on a first attempt.

dropped.description: Each branch dropped, with the commit it pointed at, so its work can be found again; left out when none was.

commit.description: The commit it pointed at, in full; git branch <name> <commit> brings it back until git collects it.
